text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The time has come! Among the abundant shrines and temples of Kyoto, we face the grand trial for the Kikuka crown!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: We worked so hard to get here, I can almost see my life passing before my eyes…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
choice_data_list: I don't think it's your time to go just yet…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You're right! This is still only the beginning!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho is a fiendishly long 3,000 meters. I've never raced such a distance before…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: But with all this luck I've scraped together, I'm sure we'll make it through somehow!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Go forth, my little lucky charms! Crush my competition! And maybe level off the dreaded Yodo Hill while you're at it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I'll just sit back and see how it goes…
choice_data_list: You better put in some effort too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I know! I'm doing my part. I drank my lucky milk today to keep my energy up.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If we get through this, no one will be able to stand against my faith. O gods, let them see the power of unparalleled luck!
